verdict.rationale: Remote's pricing page documents onboarding and paying contractors in 190+ countries, with invoice approval or auto-pay, and the homepage lists contractor management as a core product. That covers the core 'pay international contractors' part of the story. The evidence never says payments are made in local currencies, and never describes compliant contractor contract generation; it only refers to 'contracts' generically as API sync data. Missing for 10: evidence of local-currency payouts, documentation of compliant or localized contractor agreements, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can pay international contractors in their local currencies with compliant contracts

citations.quote: Onboard and pay contractors in 190+ countries
One platform for global payroll, EOR, and contractor management.
